unsloth/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct.description: Recommended default — an ungated community re-upload of Meta's Llama 3.3 70B Instruct. Chosen over the official meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct entry because that one is Hugging-Face-gated on Featherless (HTTP 403 'Unauthorized... the model is gated and you need to agree to the model's license' per https://featherless.ai/docs/api-reference-error-codes, requiring a manual 'Unlock Model' click in the account UI before first use — not credential-free-verifiable and not a good zero-touch SDK default). contextWindow and pricing are the live values from GET https://api.featherless.ai/v1/models (2026-09-28): context_length=32768, pricing.input/output already expressed as $/MTok. The vendor's per-model 'features' flag on this id reports tool_use:true, but Featherless's own Tool Calling guide (https://featherless.ai/docs/tool-calling) names only the moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Instruct and Qwen 3 model families as natively supported and says other models need a prompting workaround — so capabilities.tools is declared model-dependent at the provider level rather than assumed true for this specific id. No response_format/JSON-mode, streaming (SSE/stream:true), or combined tools+schema behavior is documented anywhere in the Featherless docs checked (Overview, API overview and common options, Completions, Quickstart, API examples, Tool Calling, Chat template kwargs, Models & Model Compatibility) — see evidence for the full list of pages checked.

meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct.description: Meta's official Llama 3.3 70B Instruct weights. The live roster (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28) marks this id is_gated:true; Featherless's error-codes page documents that a gated model 403s ('Unauthorized... need to agree to the model's license') until the account clicks 'Unlock Model' on the model's page — kept as a fallback for roster completeness, not the default, for that reason. features.tool_use:true on the live roster entry.

Not Hugging-Face-gated. Roster-listed only (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28); not itself capability-probed. features.tool_use:true on the live roster entry, but see the default model's note on capabilities.tools being provider-level model-dependent.

errorRules.message: Invalid Featherless API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}
Featherless model '{model}' is gated — sign in at featherless.ai, open the model's page and click "Unlock Model" to accept its license, or pick a non-gated model. See {setupUrl}

instructions: 1. Visit: https://featherless.ai/register and create an account (or https://featherless.ai/login if you already have one)
2. Subscribe to a plan — Chat ($25/mo, unlimited tokens, 32K context) or Developer ($50/mo in credits, billed per token, up to 256K context); Featherless has no free or keyless tier
3. Generate an API key from the API keys section of your account
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.featherless.ai/v1 ('designed to be API compatible with OpenAI' per https://featherless.ai/docs/api-overview-and-common-options), serving a roster of 22,000+ community and open-weight models — many roleplay, uncensored and abliterated fine-tunes alongside mainline Llama/Qwen/DeepSeek-derived checkpoints. Some models are Hugging-Face-gated and 403 until manually unlocked in the account UI. No free tier: plans start at $25/mo.

rosterVerified.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.featherless.ai/v1/models — 22060 models; credential-free, no key used

billingProbe.method: unauthenticated GET https://featherless.ai/pricing — no free tier mentioned anywhere on the page; plans are Chat $25/mo, Developer $50/mo in credits (billed per token), Business custom; credential-free, no key used
